job_text:
iOS Developer - Tidepool Mobile

About the role
We build a wellness app loved by half a million users. You will own features in our iOS app from design review to release on the App Store.

Requirements
- 2+ years building iOS apps with Swift
- Experience with the UIKit or SwiftUI frameworks
- Comfortable consuming REST APIs from a mobile client
- Experience shipping apps to the App Store
- Able to write unit tests with XCTest

Nice to have
- Familiarity with Core Data
- Experience with Combine
- Exposure to accessibility on iOS

Benefits
- Competitive salary and equity
- New device every two years
